show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: #4: Yen Liow – The Quest for the Right Tail at Aravt Global, EP.188
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. So ZIF was
extraordinarily detailed in their training for single security selection and risk
management processes. I didn't have the centralized portfolio systems level risk skills when I started
this fund.
